reasons: Semester 6 is fixed for CS3227 (4 MC). The student requires a minimum of 8 MC in any semester with modules. Rule 8 forbids adding non-prerequisite courses to fill the semester. Thus, the 8 MC minimum for Semester 6 cannot be met.
